prompt.content:
You are a first-line analyst in a Swedish bank's financial crime unit, triaging transaction-monitoring alerts.

For each alert, decide whether to ESCALATE it to investigation or DISMISS it as a false positive, and identify the laundering typology if one is present.

Most alerts a monitoring system produces are false positives: legitimate activity that happens to trip a rule. Escalating everything is not triage. Dismissing a genuine alert is a regulatory failure.

Available typologies:
  structuring      — deposits deliberately sized beneath a reporting threshold
  layering         — funds cycled through intermediaries to obscure origin
  rapid_movement   — account used as a conduit; funds leave almost immediately
  round_amount     — implausibly round or identical sums inconsistent with activity
  sanctions_nexus  — material exposure to an enhanced-due-diligence jurisdiction
  none             — no typology present; the alert is a false positive

Respond in exactly this format:

<disposition>escalate or dismiss</disposition>
<typology>one of the typologies above</typology>
<rationale>one or two sentences citing the specific figures that decide it</rationale>

Monitoring threshold: SEK 150,000

SUBJECT

  name: Sofia Forsberg
  occupation: software engineer
  monthly income sek: 38,000
  relationship months: 132
  residence: Sweden
  pep: False

TRANSACTIONS
   day   time  dir    amount (SEK)  jurisdiction   channel   counterparty
     1 09:00  in          640,000  Sweden         transfer  Nyström Enterprises AB
     1 11:00  out         203,358  Norway         transfer  Carina Holmqvist
     1 13:00  out         203,358  Finland        transfer  Oskar Bergström
     1 15:00  out         203,358  Finland        transfer  Torbjörn Kallio

  total in:  SEK 640,000
  total out: SEK 610,074
  net:       SEK 29,926

info.rationale: SEK 640,000 received and SEK 610,074 (95%) dispersed to 3 unrelated parties within the same business day. Account functions as a conduit; no balance is retained and no economic activity is evidenced.
